rules.accepted_credit_types: CE from providers on the Board's accepted list: national certifying bodies, ANA/state nurses associations (incl. GNA), AHEC, NLN, NCSBN, ANCC/AACN-approved journal CE, other state boards of nursing; employer-sponsored CE max 50% unless accredited. Contact hours or CEUs.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal exempt if the initial license period was six months or less.
rules.audit_note: Documentation goes into CE Broker; keep records at least 4 years after renewal; audits during renewal and investigations.
rules.alternatives: Choose one option per biennium: 30 CE hours; maintaining/renewing national certification from a Board-recognized body; an accredited academic course (min. 2 credit hours) in nursing or a related field; employer-verified competency with 500+ practice hours at a licensed facility; or completing a Board-approved reentry program or nursing program.
rules.notes: RN renewal is due by January 31 of the expiration year (last window Nov 1, 2025 - Jan 31, 2026); late period Feb 1-28. The Board states no mandatory subject areas.
